pages.text: Industrial Foregoing provides mob farming, fluid automation, and early bio-processing at $(t2)Tier 2$().$(br2)$(bold)Role in the pack:$() $(t2)T2$() provides access to basic IF machines: Mob Crusher, Mob Duplicator, Animal Rancher, Plant Gatherer. These enable automated material farming.$(br2)$(bold)T3 upgrade:$() Advanced IF features (the more powerful/complex machines) are $(t3)T3$() content. Basic mob and plant farms are T2-accessible.$(br2)$(bold)Integration:$() IF's Fluid Crafter and Laser Drill become important for Mekanism prep at T3. Planning ahead for a Laser Drill setup in $(t2)T2$() is a good strategy for a $(t3)T3$() shortcut.$(br2)$(bold)No book needed.$() Industrial Foregoing is fully documented in JEI. Every machine has tooltips explaining its function. The $(bold)IFWiki$() at ftb.fandom.com covers advanced setups like the Mob Duplicator and Infinity Drill.
